notes: Year/system: content reflects the books currently used in 1447-1448 AH (2025-2027) after the return to TWO terms: each book is split into 'الجزء الأول' (term 1) and 'الجزء الثاني' (term 2); term = '1' or '2'. Today (Oct 2026) the school year is 1448. Grade numbering is continuous 1-12: 1-6 = الابتدائي, 7 = أول متوسط, 8 = ثاني متوسط, 9 = ثالث متوسط, 10 = أول ثانوي (السنة الأولى المشتركة), 11 = ثاني ثانوي, 12 = ثالث ثانوي. English series now in use: We Can (grades 1-3, Part 1 / Part 2), TopGoal 1/2/3 (NEW series replacing We Can in grades 4-6), Super Goal 1/2/3 (intermediate), Mega Goal 1/2/3 (secondary, نظام المسارات). Main source: the sahl.io mirror of the official Ministry books (same unit/lesson titles as the ien.edu.sa books); ien.edu.sa itself is JS-only and could not be read. Meaning of concepts_inferred: false = unit AND lesson titles were read from the book's table of contents and the concepts are taken from / closely paraphrase those titles (for TopGoal 1 the vocabulary and grammar were read from each unit's Vocabulary/Grammar lesson page; for Super Goal 1, Super Goal 2 Part 1 and Mega Goal 1 Part 1 grammar/topics come from the McGraw-Hill scope-and-sequence). true = only unit titles (or only grammar points) were verifiable, so the vocabulary topics were inferred from the unit theme: We Can 1-3 (lesson names are generic: Talk Time/Words/Phonics), TopGoal 2 and 3 (grammar verified from lesson pages, vocabulary inferred), Super Goal 2 Part 2, Super Goal 3, Mega Goal 1 Part 2 (grammar mapped from an older Mega Goal syllabus), Mega Goal 2 and 3 (unit titles only; grammar mostly omitted), and the 2nd-grade primary Life Skills Part 2 book (lesson titles reconstructed from its exercise questions on madty.net). Single-term books: التفكير الناقد (أول ثانوي) is term 1 and المعرفة المالية (أول ثانوي) is term 2 of the common first year; التقنية الرقمية 2 and 3, علم البيانات, هندسة البرمجيات, الأمن السيبراني, المواطنة الرقمية and المهارات الحياتية (ثالث ثانوي) are one-part books (placed in term 1 as listed by the source; schools may teach some in term 2 depending on path). التفكير الناقد exists only in ثالث متوسط and أول ثانوي. المعرفة المالية exists only in أول ثانوي; الإدارة المالية is a business-path (مسار إدارة الأعمال) book in ثاني ثانوي, included for completeness. Path books included under digital: علم البيانات, إنترنت الأشياء, الذكاء الاصطناعي, هندسة البرمجيات, الأمن السيبراني (مسار علوم الحاسب والهندسة) and المواطنة الرقمية. Not included (out of scope): التصميم الرقمي (ثالث ثانوي, a design/arts book: graphic design, logos, packaging, photography, UI/UX, 3D, AR/VR), التربية الفكرية (special-needs track), Chinese language, and all Islamic-studies books. The 'Expansion', 'مشروع الوحدة', 'اختبر نفسك' and 'التطبيقات' review sections were omitted. Lesson-level concepts are short Arabic noun phrases suitable for matching to cartoon drawings; English concepts are {ar, en} pairs.
